corrections.reason: The printed glyph in the second instance is clearly 6th-order ህ (ብሩህ), matching the first instance on L11 and standard Ge'ez nominative predicate adjective.
On line 13, only 'እ' is printed at the end of the line, while 'ንተ' begins line 14 (እ-ንተ). Stage 1 duplicated the 'ን' across the line break.
The printed character at the end of L18 is clearly two-legged ጻ (ጻሕሉን), not single-legged ፃ.
The printed character is two-legged ጽ (ጽዋውን), matching לጽዋዕኒ on L15.
Looking at the image on Col 3 L05, 'ከዐሥር' (one out of ten / tithe, translating አሥራተ) is clearly printed with the loop of ዐ between ከ and ሥ.
